title: Enterprise Information Conformance machine-addressable requirements

requirements.requirement: Bundle standard MUST equal RFC-CS2-001 and schema_version MUST be cs2.conformance.v1.
requirements.falsifier: A bundle naming another standard or schema version.

requirements.requirement: Subject MUST carry non-empty id, kind, and immutable revision.
requirements.falsifier: Missing/empty subject id, kind, or revision.

requirements.requirement: Bundle MUST contain at least one claim with a unique id and predicate.
requirements.falsifier: Zero claims, duplicate claim id, or empty predicate.

requirements.requirement: Bundle MUST contain at least one source with stable id, kind, and locator.
requirements.falsifier: No source or source missing id/kind/locator.

requirements.requirement: Bundle MUST contain at least one evidence object bound to the exact subject.
requirements.falsifier: No evidence or evidence subject_ref differs from subject.id.

requirements.requirement: Every evidence source_ref MUST resolve to an existing source id.
requirements.falsifier: Evidence references an undeclared source.

requirements.requirement: Every non-UNKNOWN claim MUST reference at least one source or evidence object.
requirements.falsifier: Non-UNKNOWN claim with empty source_refs and evidence_refs.

requirements.requirement: Every claim MUST use the CS2 standing vocabulary.
requirements.falsifier: Claim standing absent or outside the vocabulary.

requirements.requirement: Every non-REFUTED claim MUST carry a non-empty falsifier observation.
requirements.falsifier: Non-REFUTED claim lacks falsifier.observation.

requirements.requirement: Ids MUST be unique across sources, evidence, and claims.
requirements.falsifier: Same local id appears in more than one object namespace.

requirements.requirement: Every contradicts reference MUST resolve to another claim id.
requirements.falsifier: Claim contradicts an undeclared claim id.

requirements.requirement: Route MUST name consumer, workflow, projection_id, minimum_level, and delivery_semantics.
requirements.falsifier: Any required route field missing.

requirements.requirement: Route projection_authority MUST equal NONE.
requirements.falsifier: Projection claims any authority value other than NONE.

requirements.requirement: route.minimum_level MUST be a known CS2 level not greater than bundle requested level.
requirements.falsifier: Unknown or impossible minimum level.

requirements.requirement: Process binding MUST name ocel_ref, receipt_schema, replay_binding, and episode_id.
requirements.falsifier: Missing process binding field.

requirements.requirement: Process binding MUST contain at least one event_ref.
requirements.falsifier: C4 bundle with no process event references.

requirements.requirement: A non-NONE consequence_class MUST name authority_requirement but does not infer authority.
requirements.falsifier: Consequential C4 bundle omits authority requirement or claims authority by conformance.

requirements.requirement: Requested level MUST be satisfied by the highest achieved monotonic level.
requirements.falsifier: requested_level ranks above actual_level.

requirements.requirement: Semantic fingerprint MUST be deterministic over canonical bundle semantics and exclude derived conformance output.
requirements.falsifier: Same semantic input produces different fingerprint or derived output changes fingerprint.

requirements.requirement: Consumer projections MUST preserve subject identity/revision, claim/evidence/source ids, standing, falsifiers, and semantic fingerprint.
requirements.falsifier: Projection changes or drops a required semantic identity without explicit migration.

non_claims: Conformance does not prove external provider acceptance.
Conformance does not establish current standing.
